content: Aɣelleb n Jidɛun x Midyan
Xenni nnan as yeryazen n Ifrayim: “Manawya i d aneɣ da teggid, aqa cek war i d xaneɣ třiɣid umi teffɣed, ḥima ad temmenɣed ak-d Midyan?” Uca nitni mmcubbecen akides aṭṭas.
Jidɛun yarra-dd xasen: “Mani i dd ɣa yas min ggiɣ ak-d min teggim? Ma war iǧi ařqaḍ n min iyuran n uḍiř n ayt n Ifrayim xar zi řɣiǧet n binu n ayt n Abiɛazar?
SIDI igga Ɣurab d Di’ab, řḥukkam n Midyan, deg ufus nwem. Min zemmareɣ ad ggeɣ ad t ssemquddeɣ akidwem?” Umi netta inna awař-a yarsa uxeyyeq nsen.
Umi dd-yusa Jidɛun ɣar L’Urdun, iẓwa netta ak-d teřt-mya n yeryazen nni tuɣa ɣares iǧan. Nitni fnan řami ten qqimen ḍeffaren ayt n Midyan.
Inna netta i yeryazen n Sukkut: “Ttzawgeɣ, wcem i řgens i dd ayi iḍfaren x iḍaren ticnifin n weɣrum, maɣar nitni fnan u necc aqa ḍeffareɣ Zabaḥ d Ṣalmunnaɛ, ijeǧiden n Midyan.”
Maca řḥukkam n Sukkut nnan: “Zabaḥ d Ṣalmunnaɛ, ma aqa aten deg ufus nnec, maḥend ad newc aɣrum i řɛeskar nnec?”
S uya inna Jidɛun: “Xenni řexxu, xmi d ayi ɣa igg SIDI Zabaḥ d Ṣalmunnaɛ deg ufus inu, xenni ad awem ssarewteɣ aysum n arrimet nwem ak-d isennanen d yeẓra n tmessi zi řexřa.”
Uca igeɛɛed ssenni ɣar Fanuwil uca issiweř amenni akidsen. Arrin-dd xas yeryazen n Fanuwil am mammec i dd-arrin yeryazen n Sukkut.
S uyenni issiweř ɛawed ak-d yeryazen n Fanuwil, inna: “Mařa necc ɛeqbeɣ-dd di řehna, ad hedmeɣ ṣṣumɛet-a ta.”

Tuɣa Zabaḥ d Ṣalmunnaɛ ak-d řɛeskar nsen di Karkur, tuɣa aten ɛřaḥař di xemmesṭac-ařef n yeryazen, marra inni tuɣa iqqimen zi marra řɛeskar n ayt n ccarq. Aqa mya u-ɛicrin-ařef n yeryazen inni izemmaren x ssif tuɣa ttwanɣen ɛad.
Uca igeɛɛed Jidɛun ak-d webrid n yinni izeddɣen deg iqiḍan, ɣar ccarq n Nubaḥ d Yujbaha u netta iɣřeb x řɛeskar nni, umi iɛeskariyyen di řmargeḥ ittɣiř asen aqa aten di řaman.
Zabaḥ d Ṣalmunnaɛ arewřen uca netta iḍfar i-ten. Iṭṭef tnayen n ijeǧiden n Midyan, Zabaḥ d Ṣalmunnaɛ, d imeḥbas uca issiggʷed marra řɛeskar.
Umi dd-iɛqeb Jidɛun, mmis n Yuwac, zeg umenɣi, ikka x tsunta n Ḥaras,
iṭṭef ijj n webřiɣ zeg yeryazen n Sukkut d ameḥbus uca isseqsa t. Wanita yura as marra ismawen n řḥukkam n Sukkut d imɣaren nsen, sebɛa u-sebɛin n yeryazen.

Umi dd-yiweḍ netta ɣar yeryazen n Sukkut, inna: “Ina d Zabaḥ d Ṣalmunnaɛ, inni zi i d ayi tessbarrqem umi tennam: ‘Ma Zabaḥ d Ṣalmunnaɛ aqa aten deg ufus nnec ař ɣa newc aɣrum i yeryazen nnec nni yuḥřen?’”
Xenni iṭṭef imɣaren n tendint d isennanen d iẓra n tmessi zi řexřa uca igga iryazen n Sukkut ad zzayes acan.
Lburj n Fanuwil ihdem i-t u inɣa iryazen n tendint.
Xenni inna i Zabaḥ d Ṣalmunnaɛ: “Mammec iǧan yeryazen nni tenɣim di Tabur?” Nitni arrin-dd xas: “Nitni tuɣa aten am cek, ɣarsen addud d ijjen ak-d iḥenjiren n ujeǧid.”
Xenni inna: “Nitni tuɣa d aytma, iḥenjiren n yemma. S tidett am iddar SIDI, mři ten tejjim ad ddaren, iři war kenniw neqqeɣ!”
Xenni inna i Yatar, amenzu nnes: “Kkar, neɣ i-ten!” Maca abřiɣ war dd-ikkis ssif nnes, minzi netta iggʷed umi ɛad d abřiɣ.

Xenni nnan Zabaḥ d Ṣalmunnaɛ: “Kkar cek simant nnec uca neɣ aneɣ, maɣar mammec aryaz, ammu tizemmar nnes.” Uca ikkar Jidɛun, inɣa Zabaḥ d Ṣalmunnaɛ uca iksi tiziriwin timeẓyanin i d yuyřen ɣar irawen n iřeɣman nsen.
Aɛbed n l’aṣnam zi Jidɛun d řmewt nnes
Uca iryazen n Israil nnan i Jidɛun: “Ḥekmet xaneɣ, cek uřa d mmic d wayyaw nnec, maɣar cek tfekked aneɣ zeg ufus n Midyan.”
Inna asen Jidɛun: “Necc war xawem ḥekkmeɣ uřa d mmi war xawem iḥekkem. SIDI d wenni i xawem i ɣa iḥekmen.”
Jidɛun yarni inna asen: “Necc xseɣ ad zzaywem ttareɣ ca. Ad ayi iwc kuř ijj n weryaz ict n texrazt zi tkeccaḍt nnes!”, minzi ttwafen ɣarsen texrazin n wureɣ, maɣar nitni tuɣa aten d ayt n Ismaɛil.
Nitni nnan: “Neccin ad ac tent newc s řxaḍar!” Nitni bezzɛen ijj n werruḍ uca kuř aryaz inḍar xas ict n texrazt zi tkeccaḍt nnes.

Tixrazin n wureɣ nni ittar weznent sbeɛṭac-mya n ciqlu wureɣ, nhřa tiziriwin timeẓyanin d texrazin di ṣṣifet n tuddimin d werruḍ arjuwani i tuɣa yarḍen ijeǧiden n Midyan, nhřa tiseddyin i yuyřen ɣar irawen n iřeɣman nsen.
Jidɛun igga zzayes ijj n upalṭu n ukehhan uca igga i-t di tendint nnes, di Ɛafra, u marra Israil yuyur awarni as am awarni i yict n temɣart n farq-ccɣeř. Aya idweř d řfex i Jidɛun d taddart nnes.
Ammu tuɣa innbehdeř Midyan zeg ayt n Israil uca war zemmaren ad ssgeɛɛden azeǧif nsen ɛad. Tuɣa tammurt tareyyeḥ arebɛin n iseggʷusa deg wussan n Jidɛun.
Uca Yarubbaɛl, mmis n Yuwac, yuyur uca izdeɣ ɛawed di taddart nnes.
Jidɛun tuɣa ɣares sebɛin n iḥenjiren inni dd-iffɣen zi tmeṣṣaḍt nnes, minzi tuɣa ɣares aṭṭas n temɣarin.
Uřa d tayya nnes tenni tuɣa iǧan di Cakim, tejja as-dd ijj n uḥenjir u netta igga as Abimalik.
Jidɛun, mmis n Yuwac, immut umi acuwwaf nnes tuɣa icab aṭṭas uca nḍřen t deg wenḍeř n babas Yuwac, di Ɛafra, tandint n Abiɛazari.
Awarni řami immut Jidɛun, imsar, aqa ayt n Israil dewřen-dd uca ssfesden ixef nsen am uyuren awarni i ‘Ibaɛlen’ uca ggin Baɛl-Barit d arebbi nsen.
Ayt n Israil war fekkaren ɛad di SIDI, AREBBI nsen, wenni ten ifekken zeg ufus n marra řɛedyan i d asen dd-innḍen
uca war ssecnen tamexsiwt icewwaren i taddart n Yarubbaɛl, d tenni n Jidɛun, x marra řxar i igga di ṭṭweɛ n Israil.
